fin-three-empty-relation-not-reflexive.signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.empty_relation_not_reflexive :
  (Std.Symm fun x x_1 => False) ∧ (IsTrans (Fin 3) fun x x_1 => False) ∧ ¬Std.Refl fun x x_1 => False

fin-three-le-not-symmetric.signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.le_relation_not_symmetric :
  (Std.Refl fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) ∧ (IsTrans (Fin 3) fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) ∧ 0 ≤ 1 ∧ ¬1 ≤ 0

Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.finite_relation_iff (a b : Fin 3) :

int-parity-classes-infinite.signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.parity_classes_infinite :
  (Set.range fun k => 2 * k).Infinite ∧ (Set.range fun k => 2 * k + 1).Infinite

int-parity-classes.signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.parity_classes :
  (∀ (n : ℤ),
      {x | Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.paritySetoid x n} =
        if Even n then Set.range fun k => 2 * k else Set.range fun k => 2 * k + 1) ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.paritySetoid.classes =
        {Set.range fun k => 2 * k, Set.range fun k => 2 * k + 1} ∧
      (Set.range fun k => 2 * k) ≠ Set.range fun k => 2 * k + 1

int-parity-label-descends.signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.parity_label_descends :
  ∃ v, (∀ (n : ℤ), v ⟦n⟧ = Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.parityLabel n) ∧ v ⟦0⟧ = 0 ∧ v ⟦1⟧ = 1

int-parity-successor-descends.signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.parity_successor_descends :
  ∃ s, (∀ (n : ℤ), s ⟦n⟧ = ⟦n + 1⟧) ∧ s ⟦0⟧ = ⟦1⟧ ∧ s ⟦1⟧ = ⟦0⟧ ∧ Function.Involutive s

map-kernel-classes-nonempty-fibers.signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.kernel_classes_eq_nonempty_fibers.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) :
  (Setoid.ker f).classes = Set.range fun y => f ⁻¹' {↑y}
